reason: A read-only Settings panel plugin that fetches the current session's skill catalog and presents searchable skill summaries; its primary user-facing purpose is adding a navigation page.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的设置面板中提供可搜索的只读 Skills 列表，展示当前会话可用技能的名称和路由说明。
summaries.en: Adds a searchable read-only Skills page to DeepSeek Harness Web settings, showing names and routing metadata for skills available in the current session.

capabilities: Registers a Skills page in the Settings panel
Reads the current session's user-invocable skill catalog through the existing skill.list API
Displays and locally filters skill metadata in a read-only interface
